title: 第16章 取之不尽用之不竭
novel_title: 开局废灵根，成了宗门团宠小师叔
content_zh:
顾念念冷怔怔地坐在地上。

    才短短几天，可现在她满脑子都是胡三陪着她的画面。

    她其实很聪明的。

    她知道胡三不是真心对她，她在皇城根下见过太多类似的人了。

    他们眼底带着功利，带着私心，带着所求。

    胡三也是这样的。

    可他对她也是很好的。

    会细心叮嘱，会给她弄好吃的，甚至拿命挡在她前面。

    老乞丐明明说过的，不要去喜欢一个人。

    她抬手按在自己的胸口。

    明明她没有喜欢胡三，为什么心口这么疼。

    桃夭绕在她的身边，一声声急急的唤着：“主人，主人……”

    洛靳蹲下身来，将手按在她弱小的肩膀上。

    “念念，你还好吗？”

    顾念念低着头，眼泪一滴一滴地砸在地上。

    她不好，很不好。

    顾衍不知道何时站在了她的面前。

    她抬眼看去，他还是她第一次见时的仙人模样。

    明明他说过她不会再被欺负的，可为什么？为什么胡三还是死了，自己还是被欺负了。

    “骗子！”

    第一声很轻。

    “骗子！”

    第二声她陡然提高了音量。

    到了最后一声，她几乎是嘶吼。

    “骗子！”

    顾衍看到了她眼底的怒和恨，可他依旧是冷漠的。

    但一个小玉瓶却无声地落在顾念念的面前。

    洛靳眸光一抖，有些意外地看向顾衍。

    顾衍看着顾念念，声音里只有冷漠，没有一丝多余的感情。

    “这个玉瓶里是他破碎的神魂，想要救他就自己变得更强。”

    顾念念睫毛颤了颤。

    慢慢将小玉瓶捡起，紧紧抓在手中。

    顾衍冰眸里划过一抹异样的光。

    “洛靳，送她去矿山。”

    ………………………………………………

    一辆灵舟划破青云宗的晨雾，朝着宗门外飞去。

    翠玉峰上，绯月尊者和程玲站在一起，冷眼看着灵舟消失在视野。

    “孟家和青云宗的关系不可以出现裂缝，你是孟家少夫人，当以孟家利益为先。”

    程玲满目怨恨，垂在身侧的手紧握成拳，指甲深深嵌入到皮肉中，鲜血滴落。

    绯月尊者将其看在眼底，嘴角掀起一抹嘲讽的笑。

    她淡淡开口：“出了这宗门，你要如何便如何。”

    程玲面色一怔，随后眼底划过一抹狂喜。

    她拱手与绯月尊者道谢。

    “今日恩情，日后我程玲必定回报。”
content_en:
Gu Niannian sat on the ground blankly.

    It had only been a few days, but now her mind was filled with images of Hu San accompanying her.

    She is actually very smart.

    She knew that Hu San was not sincere to her. She had seen too many similar people in the imperial city.

    They have utilitarianism, selfishness, and desires in their eyes.

    Hu San is also like this.

    But he was also very kind to her.

    He would give her careful instructions, prepare delicious food for her, and even risk his life to stand in front of her.

    The old beggar clearly said, don't like someone.

    She raised her hand and pressed it on her chest.

    She obviously didn't like Hu San, so why did her heart hurt so much.

    Tao Yao circled around her and called out urgently: "Master, master..."

    Luo Jin knelt down and put his hands on her weak shoulders.

    "Nian Nian, are you okay?"

    Gu Niannian lowered her head, tears falling to the ground drop by drop.

    She is not good, very bad.

    Gu Yan didn't know when he stood in front of her.

    She raised her eyes and saw that he still looked like the immortal he was when she first met him.

    He obviously said that she would not be bullied again, but why? Why is Hu San still dead and he is still bullied?

    "Liar!"

    The first sound was very soft.

    "Liar!"

    She suddenly raised her voice the second time.

    By the last sound, she almost roared.

    "Liar!"

    Gu Yan saw the anger and hatred in her eyes, but he remained indifferent.

    But a small jade bottle fell silently in front of Gu Niannian.

    Luo Jin's eyes flickered and he looked at Gu Yan with some surprise.

    Gu Yan looked at Gu Niannian, there was only indifference in his voice, without any extra emotion.

    "In this jade bottle is his broken soul. If you want to save him, you must become stronger."

    Gu Niannian's eyelashes trembled.

    Slowly picked up the small jade bottle and held it tightly in his hand.

    A strange light flashed in Gu Yanbing's eyes.

    "Luo Jin, send her to the mine."

    …………………………………………

    A spiritual boat cut through the morning fog of Qingyun Sect and flew towards the outside of the sect.

    On the Jade Peak, Lord Feiyue and Cheng Ling stood together, watching coldly as the spirit boat disappeared from sight.

    "There must be no cracks in the relationship between the Meng family and the Qingyun Sect. As the young lady of the Meng family, you should put the interests of the Meng family first."

    Cheng Ling's eyes were full of resentment, her hands hanging by her sides were clenched into fists, her nails were deeply embedded in her flesh, and blood was dripping from her eyes.

    Lord Feiyue saw it in his eyes, and a mocking smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.

    She said calmly: "After leaving this sect, you can do whatever you want."

    Cheng Ling's face was startled, and then a flash of ecstasy flashed in her eyes.

    She cupped her hands and thanked Lord Feiyue.

    "For today's kindness, I, Cheng Ling, will definitely repay you in the future."
